name: minimax-agent-router
description: Delegate only well-fitted chores to Claude Code backed by MiniMax, with task gating, Headroom token compression, project-isolated persistent worker memory, bounded parallelism, and mandatory Codex verification.

interface.shortDescription: Route suitable chores through MiniMax with compressed, project-scoped memory.
interface.longDescription: A Codex plugin that first assesses task fit, then delegates only low-risk research, documentation, tests, read-only review, and narrowly scoped mechanical implementation to Claude Code CLI through MiniMax. A router-managed Headroom proxy reduces repeated context and gives workers persistent project-isolated memory without changing global Claude settings. It enforces a five-minute default budget, bounded parallel workers, progress events, secret-free statistics, and pending-Codex review status. Codex keeps ownership of architecture, unfamiliar APIs, platform integration, security, deployment, and final verification.
defaultPrompt: Use MiniMax for safe coding chores
Check whether this task is suitable for MiniMax
Check Headroom compression and project memory
Run these independent chores in parallel
